basic_info.description:
Welcome to 2171 12th Avenue, a classic 1949 single-family home perfectly situated on the border of Golden Gate Heights and Forest Hills—two of San Francisco’s most desirable neighborhoods. This well-maintained residence captures the very best of West-side living with panoramic Pacific Ocean views from both the first and second floors, a quiet residential setting, and easy access to the friendly, walkable community of West Portal with its charming shops, cafés, and transit connections.  Key Property Details:
•	2 Bedrooms · 1 Bathroom · Approx. 1,100 sq. ft.
•	Expansive ocean and sunset views from nearly every room
•	Reverse-floorplan design with the main living areas upstairs to maximize the views
•	Spacious lower level with laundry, storage, and excellent expansion potential -  within the existing footprint, the lower level can be easily reconfigured to add a third bedroom, second bath, office, and utility room — no external structural work required (homes on this side of 12th Ave with this completed upgrade have recently sold for over $1.8 million, demonstrating the strong value potential)
•	Attached tandem garage with off-street parking
•	Lot size: approximately 2,996 sq. ft.
•	Recent updates: new water boiler, refreshed roof, and deck improvements for long-term reliability
•	Easy to maintain and low-cost to run, ideal for owner-occupiers or investors alike
